name: DocketBird
description:
Search 283 million filings from every U.S. federal district, bankruptcy, and appellate court. DocketBird enables you to uncover the relationships in federal civil litigation: start with any attorney, firm, party, or judge and explore every case they're involved in, who they've represented and opposed, and how they connect to each other. Pull a docket sheet, read a filing's full text or PDF, jump straight to any case's complaint, and track cases for new activity. Free to use — no subscription required.

**You can use DocketBird to:**

- **Retrieve a full docket sheet:** "Give me the complete docket sheet for 1:20-cv-03010 (D.D.C.), organized with the most recent filings first."
- **Read a filing's full text or PDF:** "Pull the full text of the motion to dismiss in this case and summarize its arguments."
- **Pull the complaint from any case:** "Show me every civil case my competitor filed last year in the Northern District of California, with the complaints."
- **Track case activity:** "Track this docket and tell me when there's new activity."
- **Research opposing counsel:** "What's this attorney's history with Judge Alsup?"
- **Check a party's litigation record:** "Has Acme Corp been sued in federal court before? Who represented them?"
- **Run pairwise relationship queries:** "Find every federal civil case where Kirkland & Ellis appeared opposite Wachtell, and which judges presided."

_published_faq.name: How do I add DocketBird to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DocketBird to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.docketbird.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DocketBird MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DocketBird lists 14 MCP tools, including find_court, find_litigation_relationships, get_case, get_case_calendar, get_companywide_calendar_entries, get_docket_sheet, get_document, get_document_text, list_court_systems, list_my_cases, search_cases, and search_documents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DocketBird?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DocketBird in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.
DocketBird requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DocketBird is developed by Mink LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
